name: Workload profile: Web Server
description: Precomputed compound score for Web Server workloads. A weighted average of normalised scores, each normalised to [0, 1] across all servers in the dataset. Component weights: 25% Static web RPS (1 kB, 8 conn/vCPU), 15% Static web RPS (64 kB, 8 conn/vCPU), 15% Static web throughput (256 kB, 8 conn/vCPU), 10% Geekbench HTML5 browser (multi-core), 5% Geekbench text processing (multi-core), 10% OpenSSL AES-256-CBC (16 kB blocks), 10% PassMark encryption (AES/SHA/ECDSA), 5% PassMark string sorting, 5% PassMark cached memory reads. Rationale for component selection: Primary workloads drivers are HTTP serving speed and throughput, HTML and text processing, TLS termination, and asset compression.
